title: Measures Of Inflation
definition: Measures of inflation are quantitative indices used to track the average change in prices of a basket of goods and services over time in an economy, serving as critical gauges of purchasing power and macroeconomic stability.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in UPSC Prelims regarding CPI vs. WPI, base years, institutional mandates (RBI Monetary Policy Committee), and in Mains GS-3 under 'Inclusive Growth and Mobilization of Resources'.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Measures Of Inflation.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of National Income and Macroeconomics
